'''Tauntaun Troopers''' were [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rebel trooper/Legends|troopers]] who rode on [[Tauntaun/Legends|Tauntauns]] during the events of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were largely utilized for [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] purposes, although they also saw some combat as well. They were outfitted at [[Barracks/Legends|Rebel Troop Centers]] and carried [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]].

Tauntaun Troopers saw frequent use during the events leading up to and during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], with their purposes including scouting and also battles.

==Behind the scenes==
Tauntaun troopers made their first appearance in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] in the beginning of the film. Their role was somewhat expanded in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' as a mounted infantry unit for the Rebel Alliance. Due to gameplay purposes, all mounted infantry within the Rebel Alliance were of Tauntauns, even in areas where they shouldn't thrive in.
